name: codebook
description: Run CodeBook factories from Claude Code: the CodeBook connector, a live Factory pane beside the chat, /factory, a session that knows when its folder is a factory's checkout and manages it, a factory-worker agent that works run-here stations in your checkout, proof runs the plugin makes and reports itself.

proof_hosts.title: Hosts proof runs may reach
proof_hosts.description: Hosts a proof run's checks may reach beyond this computer, separated by commas: example.com, *.example.com, example.com:8443, private:git.lan. Empty: the computer itself only, unless the repository's recipe asks for the whole network.
